title: Overthinking
coreMove: Use Overthinking as the warning label, then make the specific correction before the choice moves forward.
sourcePressure: The frozen TOC and official source notes frame Overthinking as a specific decision error around overthinking, analysis loop, next action. Traceable support includes Thinking too much: Introspection can reduce the quality of preferences and decisions.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Overthinking as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: use overthinking as the warning label, then make the specific correction before the choice moves forward.
